source.title: Hewynn - Tender Leaf
source.name: Hewynn
source.description: A tender water spirit who is skilled at continuous healing.

skills.name: Rain Prayer

description.raw: Hewynn heals all allies for 95% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) HP per second for 9s.
active: Hewynn heals all allies for 95% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) HP per second for 9s.

text: Healing amount per second is increased to 100% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) HP.
Healing amount per second is increased to 105% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) HP.
Healing amount per second is increased to 110% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) HP.
Healing amount per second is increased to 115% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) HP.

skills.description_lite: Hewynn continuously heals all allies for a duration of time.

skills.name: Healing Wave

description.raw: Hewynn heals 1 weakest ally for 280% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) of their HP.
active: Hewynn heals 1 weakest ally for 280% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) of their HP.

text: Hewynn's skill grants this effect once every 3s to 1 weakest ally while casting her Ultimate.

skills.description_lite: Hewynn heals an ally for a small amount of HP.

skills.name: Revitalize

description.raw: Hewynn heals an ally, granting an extra 120% (ATK-based) HP if their HP ratio is below 50%. This effect can trigger once every 8 - 1 (SP-based)s per ally.
active: Hewynn heals an ally, granting an extra 120% (ATK-based) HP if their HP ratio is below 50%.
This effect can trigger once every 8 - 1 (SP-based)s per ally.

text: Heals an ally and removes all their dispellable debuffs, triggering once every 6 - 1 (SP-based)s per ally.
Heals once every 6 - 1 (SP-based)s per ally, and removes dispellable debuffs once every 4 - 1 (SP-based)s per ally.
Increases the extra healing amount to 130% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: Hewynn heals allies and removes their dispellable debuffs.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Hewynn increases her ATK by 9% during battle. She gains an extra 6% ATK after casting Rain Prayer for the first time.
active: Hewynn increases her ATK by 9% during battle.
She gains an extra 6% ATK after casting Rain Prayer for the first time.

text: Hewynn increases her ATK by 12% during battle.
She gains an extra 8% ATK after casting Rain Prayer for the first time.
Hewynn increases her ATK by 14% during battle.
She gains an extra 10% ATK after casting Rain Prayer for the first time.

skills.description_lite: Hewynn increases her ATK during battle. She gains extra ATK after casting Rain Prayer for the first time.

skills.name: Tranquility

description.raw: Hewynn is unaffected for 6s while casting Rain Prayer. During this time, all allies take 30% less damage.
active: Hewynn is unaffected for 6s while casting Rain Prayer.
During this time, all allies take 30% less damage.

text: While Rain Prayer is effective, all allies take 32% less damage.
While Rain Prayer is effective, all allies take 34% less damage and receive buffs from Revitalize.
While Rain Prayer is effective, all allies take 36% less damage.

skills.description_lite: Hewynn is immune to control effects and reduces damage taken by allies while casting Rain Prayer.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Hewynn also grants the healed ally 30 Haste for 6s when Revitalize is in effect.
active: Hewynn also grants the healed ally 30 Haste for 6s when Revitalize is in effect.

skills.description_lite: Hewynn increases the target's Haste for seconds when Revitalize is in effect.
